This ordeal not only cost us financially but also resulted in the loss of valuable clients who couldn't reach us. And let's not forget the hassle of obtaining new IDs and updating contact information across all our accounts.  What happened here, is that the establishment had encouraged us to entrust our smaller bag with valuables to their receiving desk, assuring us it was a safer option than leaving them in their common area. It seemed reasonable, especially as we were heading for a day of surfing, making it impossible to take our important items into the water.  However, when our bag went mysteriously missing, their response was astonishingly disappointing. They simply explained that the bag might have been stolen from their receiving desk or perhaps mistakenly handed to another customer. They disclaimed any responsibility for the lost items within their premises. There was no system for securely storing our belongings, all the security cameras were conveniently non-functional, raising suspicions, and the staff exhibited an alarming lack of cooperation and concern for our predicament.  To validate this claim, here is a picture of the translated police report. Moon Relax Spa 🤎✨ || (Edit in response)  Please don’t add on by then claiming that the therapist had an “allergy”. The way the staff handled the situation was absolutely awful. First coming back to change the story, then telling me that I’d have to handle the reimbursement on my side. For a 5 star world class spa, I wished this didn’t happen, otherwise I would give more stars and probably would be a returning customer. The staff told me they would call me if they found anything….and they never called me back. Soooo, I’m just glad I didn’t have any jewelry, money or an expensive bathing suit in there. place_name: Slow Bali Spa - Masaje balinés en Barcelona
reviews_content: Avoid this spa! A good spa should have both great technique and a relaxing atmosphere, but this place misses the mark on both. We booked a 60-minute couples massage, but there was no welcome drink, and we were rushed straight into the room to lie down. Despite asking for stronger pressure, they charged an extra fee, but the pressure remained weak, leaving you questioning where the money went. The front desk staff was completely unprofessional—just there to collect payment, with no concern for customer experience. If I were the owner, I’d fire her and hire someone who actually knows how to greet and assist guests. The technique was below average for Barcelona and not worth the price at all. It felt like the only goal was to take money from customers without providing real value. Honestly, the massage was somewhat relaxing, but not nearly enough to justify the cost. Only two stars because it wasn't a total disaster, but definitely not a spa worth visiting. || We sincerely regret that your experience was not what you expected. At our center, we constantly work to provide quality service, and your feedback helps us identify areas for improvement. We want you to know that we are committed to improving and look forward to serving you better in the future. || The establishment is beautiful and so relaxing from the moment you walk through the door. I felt spoiled and wasn’t even in the massage room yet. Check-in was seamless, massage was incredible, highly recommend going here. Very professional staff🌸💕 … || We are delighted to hear that your visit was so enjoyable. Thank you for choosing our center as your place to relax. || Absolutely love the place. Very well maintained, clean , and professional. My husband and I booked the massage by phone 15 min prior to the appointment, and they were able to accommodate us. We look forward to welcoming you back. || The decor is superb and the facility is quite clean and tidy giving the impression you will have a pleasant massage. The service was outstanding but I was expecting a real Thai experience which in my opinion, I did not get because the professional I was assigned could not handle me properly due to my muscular body. Price paid for 2 for an hour session was around 240€. || James thanks very much for your comment and valoration. We hope to have to you again in our wellness Spa in Barcelona. Slow Spa. || Disappointing experience, not worth the price The massage was underwhelming. The therapist, though kind, lacked experience, her techniques felt inconsistent and half-hearted, making the 90 minutes feel much longer. To add to that, the AC kept switching on and off, making it impossible to fully relax. For the price, I expected a far more professional and comfortable experience. Sadly, it didn’t deliver. || We appreciate you sharing your feedback. We'll work to improve so your next visit truly reflects the level we strive to offer. || Booked a couples massage and paid through the site and setup appointment for myself and pregnant wife.  We showed up for our scheduled massage that we paid for through their website and when we got there, they told me that I only booked one. Good thing is I take screenshots of everything that I do and showed her that I booked two and showed the price that I paid and the time that I booked with the confirmation.  Then she tried to tell me that it was my fault for not booking both times through their website, which wasn’t even an option and then tried to tell me that we would have to do them back to back and spend three hours at the spa Which obviously we had no intention of doing since we don’t wanna waste the whole day there and then sit around for an hour and a half for the other one to finish.  Then she said we could both come back at 4:30 PM which again we had no desire to do since we came here specifically for this massage and so I told her to cancel.  She then told me I needed to cancel through the app, which also made no sense, since I booked through their website.  Then she stated after spending five minutes on the phone and not attempting to help us or find any accommodations that it was canceled and we should see it sometime in the next five days.  After she stated it was canceled, She tried to send us over to another massage place stating that they were partners which if that was the case, why didn’t you just start with that to begin with and send us over there for the massage?  Long story short is a terrible experience and we’ve already gotten multiple massages in Barcelona and had great experiences elsewhere so I wouldn’t come back here or spend money.  They try to overbook and lie to you.  Not anyone’s business. || We appreciate your honesty and apologize for what happened. We're working on improvements to make your next visit even more pleasant. || I am absolutely appalled by Slow Bali Spa Barcelona’s blatant false advertising. They proudly market themselves as a vegan spa — a place where people like me expect cruelty-free, plant-based values to be genuinely respected. But imagine my disgust when I discovered they’re offering a tasting menu in collaboration with a steakhouse. Yes, a steakhouse. The so-called "tasting menu" includes meat dishes. How on earth can you call yourself vegan while promoting and serving animal products?  This isn’t just misleading — it’s hypocritical and insulting. People choose vegan businesses to support ethical, sustainable, and compassionate practices. Partnering with a meat-serving restaurant is the complete opposite of that. It’s greenwashing, plain and simple.  If you’re going to market yourself as vegan, be vegan. Don’t lure customers under false pretenses only to betray the very principles you claim to uphold. It’s dishonest, unethical, and frankly disgusting.  If you actually care about integrity, drop the “vegan” label — because right now, it’s a lie. || We would like to inform you that we don´t have you registered anywhere on our spa as a customer, however we appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. We want to begin by sincerely apologizing for the confusion our communication has caused regarding the nature of our business.  We recognize that your concerns about integrity and ethics are entirely valid.  Please allow us to clarify a crucial point: In our center, some of the services we provide use only vegan products, however, this is not our entire menu. In packages that include food, we specify that the tasting menu does not include vegan options on our website to avoid customer confusion. You could also sit under the sunshine ☀️  We highly recommend the meatball, mussels (my personal favorite), and the sausage with source and mushrooms. Sometimes they also have fried meatballs on top of the counter. Definitely try them if you see new stuff! || We were impressed by the local restaurant. The food is high quality and cheap! I will definitely recommend anyone visiting La Sagrada Familia try this restaurant! My top recommendations are meatballs, Russian salad, croquettes, ham(it is delicious but also expensive). || We came to this bar for a quick lunch before visiting Sagrada Familia nearby. The place was nothing fancy but the faded 1996 Barcelona FC poster was the best demonstration of its taste and vibe.  Much to our surprise, there were a couple of middle-to-old aged locals eating in the bar but there was no tourists except us although only 2 mins walk to one of the most famous place of interest in Barcelona.  The boss spoke decent English.There was no menu. Dish explanation and order were verbally communicated. And since it wasn’t a weekend, there was less choices. Still, we didn’t quite understand what to order. So we just asked the boss to order for us.  “Meat, seafood we all like. Just give us what the locals like.” And the boss happily obliged. He also suggested the homemade Vermouth, despite we didn’t ask for drinks. And we were like “Sure!”.  When the food came, it was one of the best dishes (not just tapas) we had in the journey. It’s simple and sincere. Yes, sincere. There was nothing pretentious just every bit of a flavor that the neighbors enjoy. The meatballs were so good we ordered them again. And the vermouth upgraded the flavor to another level.  We were able to fully focus on the food and the nicely made vermouth. The whole vibe and experience were really amazing if you are looking for something local. || One of our favourite bodegas in Barcelona and at an amazing location! Sandy gave so much interesting history combined with information about where the city plans are going to that I would do another of Urbanvisor tours immediately. Well worth it! || Excellent, highly informative and entertaining!  We booked a tour for 4 people with our guide Bettina and enjoyed it very much. I definitely recommend urbanvisor if you are looking for a non-standard and memorable walking tour of Barcelona.  urbanvisor offers Barcelona tours for architecture experts and interested lay people in English, Spanisch, (Swiss-)German and Catalan.  We walked through the old town and at every stop Bettina gave us a detailed overview of the urban development of Barcelona. She had maps and plans on hand to illustrate how the city was built and changed over time, from the Roman origins until today.  This, and the possibility to ask questions any time made the tour very interactive and gave it a personalized feel.  Bettina gave a lot of background information while at the same time not overloading us as non-architecture professionals with technical details. Moran and his gallery, simply put, go absolutely above and beyond! I have yet to encounter a more kind, sincere, generous and helpful gallery owner. The pieces they selected, in addition to being relevant to the theme, were very interesting. They also gave us a wealth of information about the works and the artists. I will definitely work with this dedicated and friendly family of gallery owners again and will recommend them to all my contacts in the art world. || Thank you Alessandro, for your trust. || As an artist, working with Art Nou Mil·lenni has been a positive experience. In the end, the result was very satisfactory, and I especially appreciate that they took responsibility for resolving the issues without passing that burden on to me. place_name: Art Gallery Barcelona - Base Elements Gallery
reviews_content: While walking through the city, our attention was caught by a beautiful art gallery. There, we met the owner, Robert, who warmly welcomed us and enthusiastically showed us several works. He mentioned that his other gallery, Base Elements was just around the corner and encouraged us to stop by.  At Base Elements, we were kindly welcomed and had a long, inspiring conversation with Ivana Flores, one of the artists. She took the time to share both her work and her personal journey with us, which made the visit even more special. The art was impressive, and the atmosphere felt genuine and warm.  It turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona truly a memorable and inspiring experience. || Barceleona is one of my family's favourite cities and Base Elements is a must visit every time we come. The owner is charming and the work on display is always dynamic, unpretensious and utterly original. There's a great deal of art to be found all over the city, but this is the one place we always seek out on our little trips from Poland. || I found base elements after a couple hours of visiting different art shops around the area—Robert has the (in my opinion) the best art collection out of the different spots I went to.  Not only was the art dope but the hospitality was unrivaled. Robert talked us through the art he owned, his artists, & also shared the rich history of the district.  Truly more than a shopping experience. Definitely a spot to visit when in Barcelona. || My buddy and I stumbled across Robert’s studio after touring and seeing several other art galleries. Best experience of our Barcelona trip. We’re both from the states and Robert shared how he moved to Barcelona and described his love for this city. His passion and the environment he’s curated truly shine.  The artwork is incredible with some truly amazing pieces. Robert made the whole place authentic and gave us something that I know we’ll both share and talk about with all our friends.  My only regret is not buying this man a drink and hearing more about his stories and this city. Oh well, until next time! :D || 🔥Thank you 🔥 next time , for the drink 😎😂 … || I stumbled upon Base Elements while wandering the Gothic Quarter one morning and was immediately captivated by its stunning collection. The artwork was rich and dynamic. Robert, the gallery’s "big boss," welcomed me with open arms, sharing stories about the artists, the gallery’s history, and his own journey with a genuine passion that made the experience even more special.  Robert invited me to visit his larger gallery/studio that evening (if the door is locked, just ring the bell!) There, I was warmly greeted by the incredibly kind and talented artist Ivana Flores, whose work I’ve included in the pictures below. Ivana's art was among the most striking in the gallery, yet she remained remarkably humble, always eager to highlight the brilliance of her fellow artists. She graciously shared insights into her inspirations, and personal interpretations, making me feel as though I could have talked to her for hours.  Ivana also encouraged me to explore the studio, where she and her fellow artisans bring their masterpieces to life. Seeing the creative process up close added another layer of appreciation to the already mesmerizing experience.  What started as a spontaneous stop became the most memorable highlight of my trip to Barcelona. If you love art, storytelling, and authentic connections, check out this hidden gem! I hope this review helps fellow wanderers discover the magic of Base Elements :) || Thank you , great story !! 🔥❤️🔥 … || The best space in Barcelona to immerse yourself in the local art scene. Each piece in the gallery was beautifully unique in its own way! Thanks for telling us about the artists behind these incredible works. I will happily return to the gallery 🎨 … || By far the best gallery in town. Amazing local artists. Try to get into a chat with Robert. He is not only a true lover and connoisseur of (lokal) art, with his studio he supports artist to do all this lovely Art. || Nice selection of pieces mostly from artists born in Barcelona or living in Barcelona. The owner is easy to speak with and very knowledgeable. Worth stopping in if you need something above your kitchen table or just to raise an eyebrow || Me and my wife visited both galleries. Robert the owner was awesome. So friendly and helpful.  Relaxed not pushy with some the best art in Barcelona.  Must visit if your here. || 🔥Thank you Matthew 🔥 … || I visited the gallery several time…whenever I’m in BCN. The gallery has now been expanded to include a second large exhibition room, there is so much to discover. Robert, the owner,  takes an incredible amount of time and it was an awesome pleasure to spend time there. My work of art by Konair was packed so perfectly that I was able to take the flight home to Germany with it easily. And it’s amazing when you are walking through the streets,  you will  find a piece of his art on every corner.  If you're looking for really cool street art, you've come to the right place. Thank you for Robert and his team. We keep in touch!

Maria de la Cruz is an artist through and through. Her paintings reflect a special personality and sensitivity. I love the painting in the shop window: it conveys and tells a very intimate and unique story. She expresses and describes the paintings and her work in a very personal and friendly way. I felt very well advised. || We're so glad you enjoyed the exhibition, we hope to see you again soon! 😘 … || Excellent gallery in the upper part of Barcelona with original and varied contemporary paintings in a range of styles, techniques, and sizes. The gallery owner is very attentive and helped me with some questions I had. I'll definitely be back! || Thank you very much Daniel, we hope to see you again :)! || A great exhibition and a very talented artist!! Congratulations!! || I've exhibited at this gallery several times and it's always been great. The space is very welcoming and located in a quiet, pleasant area. I'll definitely continue exhibiting with them! || Thank you so much, we're always happy to help! 😊 … || A gallery with very beautiful works of art, of various sizes and prices. I recommend a visit if you're passing through the area and enjoy art! || Thank you so much, we hope to see you again!

Bar Eixample is a fantastic find in the heart of Barcelona’s Eixample district — the kind of place that feels local, welcoming, and consistently high-quality. The location is super convenient, easy to reach on foot or by metro, and a great stop whether you’re exploring the neighborhood or looking for a relaxed lunch or evening tapas.  What really stands out is the atmosphere. It’s stylish and modern without being pretentious, with a warm, lively buzz that makes you want to stay. There’s also outdoor seating, which is perfect when the weather is good and adds to that classic Barcelona dining feel. The place is clean, well organized, and clearly run with care.  Food-wise, Bar Eixample delivers exactly what you hope for in a Mediterranean tapas bar — fresh ingredients, bold flavors, and plates that are both traditional and a little creative. You can comfortably share a few dishes and build a full meal from the menu. Everything tasted well-balanced and properly cooked, and the kitchen clearly knows what it’s doing. The wine and drink selection pairs really well with the tapas, adding to the overall experience.  Service was another highlight: friendly, attentive, and well paced. Even when it gets busy, the team stays professional and efficient, and you feel genuinely looked after rather than rushed. They’re also happy to recommend dishes, which is always a good sign.  Value for money is excellent for Barcelona — generous portions, strong quality, and fair prices, including a very good lunch menu if you visit during the day.  Bottom line: Bar Eixample is a reliable, high-quality tapas spot with a great vibe, great food, and great hospitality. If you’re staying anywhere near Eixample, this is absolutely worth a visit — I’d happily come back anytime. || Great little spot in Eixample Barcelona, perfect for a pre dinner drink and tapas… beautiful potato bravad and a great deal on the aperol spritz.  Highly recommend. || Good, not great. We dined on several tapes plates included tacos, bravas and truffle sandwich melt. Thank you. || We came past this place and saw the amazing menu on the wall. By change they had a table available on the terrace. They have a great house gin & tonic for 5€. We originally were just looking for a place to have a cooling drink but I NEEDED (sure there is a law written  about this) to taste The ensaladilla russa with chicken. (normally it’s with tuna). It was super nice. I have to say I prefer it with chicken a lot more now I tasted this. We continued drinking here and decided to try steak tartare that was also of a super quality. Super wel cutter and presented lovely. It was great to have a good red wine with this (the Rioja). The terras and inside seem to fill up nicely whilst we were there but we never felt rushed to move for a bigger group or fully eating guests. The staff here was fantastic. Marina made us feel very welcomed and is super efficient and thoughtful. Locals and tourists come here and I heard very good English level spoken by the staff and of-course they speak Spanish normally. || Thank you very much Nicky, we hope to see you again soon. || Great spot for tapas. Good service, and food came out quick & fresh. The Parmesan & Lemon croquetas were the BEST ever :) || Great place for after work drinks and tapas. They have a very big space inside the bar, it can fit up to around 40 people! We once did a team building here, it was incredible. Service is 10 out of 10, drinks prices are very reasonable and good selection as well. Food portions are a bit smaller, but delicious. || Good selection of Spanish dishes. We shared everything between our group. To drink, you can go wrong with local vermouth. || Fantastic tapas and good service. The server helped me choose the food as I wasn't familiar with local terms. The dishes were very tasty and we'll priced. Everything was great. Only comment would be to improve the AC inside. Otherwise - highly recommended! || Thank you for your feedback, we will take it into consideration. || Best calamari and octopus I've ever tasted, great food, first class service! Highly recommend! || Overpriced, not fresh and small portions. Not sure of the other reviews.. the brava sauce was marinara without any spices, the bocata de calamars were 6.50€ and more montaditos than a real bocadillo. Not as good as the cheaper classic restaurants nearby. || We are sorry for your disappointment, perhaps another time. || Nice place for a Tapas!! Atmosphere and service were super good! || Wow! Thank you for our New Years celebration after a difficult 2024 for our Family. Your kindness and hospitality made what could have been a difficult night a beautiful memory. Thank you team, we will be back x || Everything we ordered was very tasty. Especially the grilled octopus. Overall a great experience. || Best tapas I had in Spain until now! The Duck confit taco, chicken salat and patatas brava are incredible! The parmesan lemon croquettes were memorable, the duck confit tacos delicious (made even more so by the wasabi mayo add on) and the cheese ravioli for desert was an interesting take. This is a lovely restaurant with lovely people and lovely food☺️ || 🍷Thank you so much for your beautiful words! We're truly happy you felt the care and creativity behind each dish—and Patricia will be thrilled to hear your kind mention. It was a pleasure having you, and we hope to welcome you back soon for more lovely moments! 😊🍽️  … || My family and I were aimlessly walking around hungry, looking for some decent food. We stumbled across Local and boy were we more than surprised by the creative combination of flavors, the speediness of the service and the friendliness of the staff— Lin is a total sweetheart. Thanks for positive experience! || Hello! Thank you so much for visiting us and for your kind review. We are thrilled you were surprised by the creative flavors, the speedy service, and the friendliness of our staff, especially Lin. We hope to welcome you back to Local Tapas soon! || Local cuisine served just right. The shrimp is perfect, must try. Fast and warm service. Ordered the Seafood Paella, Shrimp Scampi, Grilled Octopus & Grilled Razor. San Miguel & Red Wine Sangria for drinks. Very satisfied! || It was an amazing experience. Cozy place and the waiters were friendly. The food came super fast and it was incredible, it had much flavor. We ordered paellas with octopus, beef cheeck, croquetas bacalao, carpaccio picanha, scallops and they were amazing. Also, Patricia did a great job serving us, thank you || I’ve been to Spain many times, but this is the first time I came with my husband. We chose to come here to try Spanish food, and everything was excellent — from the paella to the octopus. We truly enjoyed it, and I’ll definitely recommend this place to more friends. The service here is also very warm and welcoming, which we really appreciate. We felt very well taken care of and truly supported. || It’s a perfect example of the best hospitality and fast service. The food is extremely delicious and the variety of the local dishes is impressive. I suggest definitely I’m sending THANKS to the waitress ANNA. She is exceptionally organised, polite, helpful and professional. I wish all the best in what you are doing! || 😊 Thank you so much! We're thrilled you enjoyed the food, service, and variety of dishes. Anna will be delighted to hear your kind words. We look forward to welcoming you back soon! 🥘 … || Local Tapas is a true gem in Barcelona! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm smiles and a lively, welcoming atmosphere. The tapas are simply outstanding – fresh, creative, and full of flavor. Abby, our lovely waitress, made the evening even better with her friendly personality and great menu suggestions. Every bite was a delight, and the service was top-notch. Five shining stars – can’t wait to come back! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 || Nice tapas bar in the city center. Everything was good, and my favorites were the tuna tartare with guacamole and the camembert. But overall, nothing really stood out enough to make me want to come back anytime soon. || Thank you for visiting Local Tapas and for your honest feedback. We are happy you enjoyed the tuna tartare with guacamole and the camembert. We are sorry that nothing stood out enough to encourage a quick return and would love for you to visit again so we can truly impress you next time! || Highly recommend! Food was amazingly delicious. Lin was serving us warmly and nicely. We’ll definitely come back again next time. Highly recommend again :)

We had a great experience here! We ordered the tapas set menu and thought it was really good value. The staff were all very friendly and welcoming.  The tapas and paella are made in the traditional way (the rice is slightly al dente), and everything was delicious. The dessert with pineapple was a pleasant surprise — very unique and tasty — and the chocolate ganache was absolutely amazing.  Strongly recommended! || We stumbled upon this elegant eye catching art deco prohibition style restaurant (previously a speakeasy bar), even their restroom is a sparkling gem:)  We were further impressed by their dinner menu with various carefully selected delicious tapas, and amazingly rich seafood paella. And don’t forget their pairing wine selections are a must! Lastly but not least is the wonderful owner Juan and our maître d'hôtel Miguel. Their hospitality made our Barcelona trip an important reason to come back again. Not just for the food and culture, but for friendship! || Many thanks How for your visit from  NYC. It was a pleasure for us to have your visit. Hope to see you again with your family before you fly back to your hometown. Happy New Year || Our first night and meal in Barcelona. Xavi provided exceptional service (he is the reason we would like to give this place 6 stars if it was possible). He was very attentive and spoke very good english - understood all of our requests and went above and beyond with a friendly smile. The food was just as exceptional. We ordered the salmon, meatballs, mussels, and my favorite - the fried beef with truffle and egg. All were super delicious. Don’t miss this place when you are in Barcelona!! || I had a wonderful time here! Everything was so delicious, and the staff were all very polite. In particular, Mr. Xavi was friendly and professional. I will definitely visit again soon. Highly recommend! || Many thanks Taimin for visiting Secret Tapas. It was a pleasure for us having your visit. Merry Christmas || Highly recommend this place. Food is exceptional. The seafood paella is one of the best. Chargrilled cod is beautifully done, fresh, flavourful and caramelised to perfection. Octopus is also grilled nicely and tender. || the service was immaculate, the location was beautifully decorated in theme for christmas, the red house wine was very flavourful and if you are looking for a tradition tapas and paella place close to diagonal, its the place to go !!! out service by miguel was exceptional. The dishes are very good and the food comes quickly. || Excellent food and  chic environment, the waiters especially Xavi is awesome and funny. He is also very helpful and kind to recommend delicious food :) || The food was good but not exceptional. The food was overpriced. This place can also be found as “Cheri” on Google map and has less good reviews. It seems like they created a new business on Google “Secret tapes” to have better reviews than Cheri. On the menu it was clearly written Cheri and not Secret Tapes. || Many thanks Louis for visiting Secret Tapas. Enjoy the rest of your trip in Barcelona. Regards || Migue is friendly and attentive! Great recommendations on different delicious dishes. We had a great evening at Cheri/secret Tapas. || Many thanks Tina for visiting Secret Tapas. Regards || Great service and great food. Topped off by our helpful waiter Miki who helped guide us through the menu and drinks and offered excellent service. I would definitely recommend! || Many thanks Ben for your visit to Secret Tapas. Thanks for choosing us. Wish you a happy New Year || Had such a great time there! Good service, great food options and reasonable prices. The sea bass was especially tasty. Would visit again! || Had a great meal here, Miguel and all the staff were friendly and attentive, I was dining alone this time but this is a great spot for groups, beautiful interior and clean terrace. I definitely recommend dining here! || I loved my experience here we had tapas and sangria. The server Xavi was amazing!!!! He even took our pictures and in all the angles! The food was 10/10 have to try their chocolate truffles as well! || Secret Tapas delivers fantastic food (loved the sizzling garlic prawns!), but the **real standout is the impeccable service.** The staff were **efficient, friendly, and genuinely warm**, creating a wonderful atmosphere. From ordering our tapas (ham platter, Burrata, mussels, squid, paella, prawns) to the seamless flow of the meal, their attentiveness made the whole experience divine. || I had an amazing time dining here! The grilled octopus was absolutely delicious — tender, flavorful, and beautifully presented. It was definitely the highlight of the meal.  The service was fantastic as well. Our waiter, Miki, was incredibly friendly and helpful, making us feel very welcome throughout the evening. The atmosphere was cozy and relaxed — perfect for a date or a laid-back dinner with friends.  Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Catalan flavors with excellent service. I would definitely come back! || many thanks for your coment Flora, we hope to see you soon at Secret Tapas || So good restaurant! Migoel gives us a surprise after dinner, he is so nice and gentle . I like this restaurant very much! Hope everyone will like it || We had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was delicious — everything was fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented.  But what truly made our visit unforgettable was the service. The waiter who served us (the one in the photo) was absolutely perfect — extremely professional, kind, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcomed. He explained the menu with patience, checked on us at the right moments, and added such a warm touch to the whole evening.  Overall, a wonderful place with great food and exceptional service. Highly recommended! || Beautiful setup, amazing food & great amount of portions, and wonderful service all together || Excellent, excellent food, service, and atmosphere. We found this place on our first night in Barcelona and the other places we went too were good but this place was better. We ended up coming back a second time and got a different set of entrees (but some of the same tapas) and it was absolutely delicious both times. The classic sausage and beans was beautifully seasoned and the sausage was crisp on the outside and tender and moist inside. The chicken was also crispy on the outside and juicy and flavorful inside. Their patatas bravas are really special and look gorgeous but also come with a well seasoned set of sauces. Secret Tapas is very highly recommended. || Gentlemans on welcoming and taking orders were so nice, helpful. Ms. Andrea took care the rest also very professional, thanks to all. About food; everything was very good

This restaurant is absolutely amazing! We ordered the seafood paella, eggplant tapas, and cod, and every dish was delicious with fresh ingredients and rich flavors. The service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and welcoming from start to finish. The atmosphere and ambiance of the restaurant were warm and pleasant, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal and relax. Highly recommended, and I will definitely come back! We also meet tamara, she was incredibly warm and friendly, and took the time to explain each dish in detail, including their flavors and the best pairings. Her attentive and professional service made our meal even more enjoyable. Truly outstanding! || I had an amazing experience. The food was great and our waitress Tamara was fantastic. She was beyond attentive and has such a bubbly spirit and light.  The burger was cooked perfectly and the bread was super fresh. The prawn croquettes were delicious and flavorful. The oyster was super fresh.  The chocolate cake was soft and warm.  Only reason I gave 4/5 stars for food was because I didn’t get to try the paella. || The food is reasonably good, with the secreto fillet being a standout highlight. Service was attentive and pleasant. A nice touch was the live singer who moved around the restaurant and interacted with diners, creating a warm and enjoyable atmosphere.  Reservation is required. || One of the best Tapas Bars Barcelona has to offer. Pinned this place when I was researching about best tapas bars before going to Barcelona and managed to go there on the last night before heading back to India.  The place definitely did not disappoint. The food was great like many other tapas bars but the atmosphere was lovely. Live music and the crowd made the whole experience amazing. || Let me explain why I gave service 3 stars, the server was good and attentive how ever if you ask me to give you 5 stars I am not going to do that hence why I comprised and gave 3 stars. Had she not asked me to give her 5 stars she would have received it. The food was good, a lot of flavor and plentiful. My hotel concierge recommended this restaurant. The cocktails were really good! || We had an amazing experience at Vivo Tapas in Barcelona! We ordered the grilled octopus, crispy corn, sautéed clams, Iberico pork, Anchovy toast and enjoyed a glass of red wine, a glass of white wine, and sangria. Everything was absolutely delicious — perfectly cooked and full of flavor.  But the highlight of our visit was the outstanding service from Melina. She was warm, attentive, and made our dinner feel extra special. || Vivo has amazing tapas!  The ambiance is modern and the food is very refined with classic Mediterranean flavors.  The anchovy toast was very subtle.  The Andalusian squid was cooked to perfection.  The sea bass carpaccio fresh and vibrant.  The cocktails were mixed with a subtly and to perfection!   Melina provided exceptional service.  She is very attentive without being overbearing! || Excellent seafood and black squid paella! We couldn’t choose between them, so we got both! We also enjoyed our appetizers, tomato bread and two types of croquettes, prawn and ham. Our server, Tamara was so pleasant and answered all of our questions. She has a great vibe and made our experience one we will remember. We happened to be here during a live performance with a wonderful singer. We are only in town tonight, but when we return to Barcelona, this will be our go-to Paella place! Thanks Tamara, you’re a sweetheart! || The food is excellent!  The goat cheese salad and lobster paella are to die for.  Paired with a sangria it doesn’t get any better.  Our server was Tamara and she was friendly and Helpful.  Very good personality and was a joy to have waiting on us.    Highly recommend. We give this an A+ || I have a very mixed feeling and experience with this place. The vibe here was absolutely amazing! They have awesome live music and singer. Drinks were good! Food was ok. They were extremely busy when I was there. I came by alone, so chose to seat at the bar which is a huge mistake. It’s extremely difficult to talk or hear. So half of my order was incorrect. I wanted Squid ink seafood rice but I ended up got the clam and mussels seafood rice. 2 orders of oysters ended up got 3. The seafood rice minimum required x2 orders to make.I ordered 2 drinks, classic cocktail and whiskey sour, they are all very good. I also tried the scallops with caviar, not a fan. Because of the misconceptions of seafood rice, the bill was over 120 euros myself. Overall, food was good but slightly salty for me.  I think everyone there were nice and friendly, just way too busy and overwhelmed.

place_name: Corte de Manga l Restaurante de Tapas Barcelona
reviews_content: Corte de Manga is located in a residential area L’ Antiga Esquerra and is definitely not a typical tourist trap tapas bar. The food was phenomenal along with the service. Finding it was completely happenstance and we were very thankful to discover this gem. The tomatoes and bread is a must and the eggplant with honey was delicious and the chicken croquettes were fantastic. || Thanks a lot, Nick. It means a lot to read such a detailed review. We’re really glad you ended up finding us by chance and that the tapas hit the mark for you.  The tomatoes with bread and the eggplant with honey are two classics, así que nos alegra que los disfrutaras, igual que las croquetas de pollo. And it’s good to know the service and the quiet residential atmosphere added to the experience.  Thanks for stopping by — you’re welcome any time you’re around the area again. || Amazing food, really special and everything tastes exquisite. Couldn’t get a spot inside without reservation but outside was cute too. Can very much recommend the eggplant and patatas bravas. || Hello Amy! Thank you very much for your comment. We are glad you enjoyed the tapas. We hope to see you again soon. || The food here was some of the best tapas I have had for a very affordable price. Our waiter Victor was amazing with recommendations; he suggested getting the truffle artichoke and ham tortilla which was incredible. Between three, we had the tortilla, patatas bravas, meatballs, oxtail croquettes and the chorizo in cider. I would also highly recommend the Vermut for only €4! The interior is also beautiful - minimalist retro interior with warm lighting and good vibes. Ask for Victor when you come here and you will not regret it :) || Loved the food especially the toasted avocado with eggs  Noelia was our waiter , she was amazing and so lovely to handle all my strange requests always smiling and service was perfect. Absolutely will come again. || I was out for a walk when this charming restaurant caught my eye, so I decided to give it a try. The service was absolutely outstanding, with attentive and friendly staff who made the experience even more enjoyable.  I sat at one of their outdoor tables, which was a perfect spot to relax and with great atmosphere. I ordered a coffee and their chicken and waffles, and everything was delicious! The flavors were spot-on, and the presentation was great too.  Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area! A wonderful place for great food, excellent service, and a lovely outdoor dining experience. || Thank you for the lovely review, Alec! We're delighted you enjoyed our outdoor atmosphere. We hope to see you again soon at Corte de Manga! || Second best croquettes I have ever had (first is grandpa’s), super nice in this little piazza in a great part of Barca and really nice staff. Mellow atmosphere and gourmet food. Now my favorite tapas bar in the city || The food was excellent, prices were awesome, particularly for its location on consell de cent. Really enjoyed the visit and would highly recommend it. I wish they'd use locally roasted coffee, cause there are so many great options, but great experience! || Thank you so much, David! We’re glad you enjoyed our brunch and appreciated the location and value. We take note of your suggestion about locally roasted coffee—quality and proximity are also part of our values. Looking forward to welcoming you back soon! || We went to Corte De Manga for brunch, and it was such a good decision! The food was super full of flavor and beautifully presented. The staff were really friendly and attentive, which made us feel right at home. The atmosphere was also lovely and just right for a relaxed brunch.  All in all, a great experience. We’ll definitely be coming back! || Thank you so much for your lovely words! We’re thrilled to hear that your brunch at Corte de Manga was such a good experience — from the flavors and presentation to the atmosphere and service. We really do our best to create a space where people feel welcome and can enjoy honest food made with care. It means a lot to us that you felt at home here. We can’t wait to have you back! || Stopped for a quick lunch on arrival in Barcelona. The atmosphere at night is probably much livelier and fun. It was fine at 1pm. Brilliant server, so friendly. Service was smooth and helpful 👌 We had two very tasty tapas dishes, the cod croquettes and the Spanish omelette (tortilla). Both excellent quality. Brilliant choice of drinks too. || It’s been a while since I’ve experienced such a perfect combination of a great place and excellent service! Nicolás was incredible with us truly amazing service! And the food? Out of this world! || Thank you so much Lauraa! We’re thrilled you enjoyed both the service and the atmosphere — Nicolás will be happy to hear your kind words. Next time, we’d love for you to try some of our signature tapas, like the Catalan-style meatballs, the truffled tortilla, or the baked camembert with honey and walnuts. We’re all about good food, great vibes, and memorable tapas moments — see you soon!

Another great architectural work by Gaudi. His characteristic style makes the park feel extremely natural, human intervention intertwining with natural elements. if you like walking and have a spirit of exploration this is a place not to be missed! || An outstanding example of Gaudí's connection with and inspiration from nature. Something you won't see anywhere except this place. || Composed of curved walls and asymmetrical columns, the structure features a sculpture known as "The Washerwoman." This sculpture depicts a woman balancing a water jar on her head while doing laundry, symbolizing the harmony between human labor and nature. Designed to follow the slope of the hill, the structure utilizes natural lighting to emphasize spatial depth, showcasing Gaudí's philosophy of seamlessly integrating architecture with the natural landscape. || My wife and I took a look at Park Güell with interest. There are many attractions in the park and among them is certainly the rather unusual Portic de la Bugadera. It has a special wavy shape with sloping columns made of raw stone. It is an example of organic architecture. || Portic de la Bugadera is not only a Naturalist style architecture, its combination of aesthetic expressions and practical use is what I appreciate the most. || This park is definitely worth a visit.  There is a load of unusual buildings/structures to see, plenty of winding paths and seats to rest at. || Beautiful alley within Guell park. Beautiful views from here of city aswell. || Got us a mini tour by a local brasilian man who explain us better of how this works than the people that worked there 💀 || Its ok. Overrun by tourists, of course, but more than that there are about three or four colonnades that look a whole lot like this one and eventually, as you see them one after another they start blending into each other. || This structure inside the park is cool

Beautiful and well maintained park. A great place to enjoy views of the city without overcrowding.  Be ready to walk up a steep hill to get to the best view and calisthenics area on top. It’s a dog friendly park and there is a small children’s playground on the way up. || Great park compared to others in Barcelona. Moderate uphill climb is rewarded with views of the city including iconic buildings like Sagrada Familia, Glories Tower and the sea on 1 side while there are views of Tibidabo on the other side. There's also a small outdoor workout area at the top with about 5 pieces of equipment. This type of green space in the city is awesome. This park would get 5 stars if it were not for all the dog poop, a too common problem in Barcelona's parks sadly. We blame the owners not the dogs. || Nestled in the hills of Barcelona, this park offers a delightful escape from the city's hustle and bustle. With its lush greenery, winding paths, and stunning views, it's the perfect spot for a leisurely stroll or a relaxing afternoon picnic. The playgrounds and open spaces provide ample room for families and friends to gather, making it a great place to unwind and connect with nature.  One of the highlights is definitely the tranquility you can find here, especially during weekdays when it's less crowded. The gentle sounds of chirping birds and rustling leaves create a serene ambiance that is ideal for mindfulness or simply enjoying a good book. Plus, the charming sculptures scattered throughout the park add a unique artistic touch. Whether you're a local or a visitor, this hidden gem deserves a spot on your itinerary. || Peaceful green escape in the city! This park is a hidden gem in Barcelona, quiet, full of nature, and perfect for a morning walk or just relaxing with a book. The view from the top is worth the climb. Highly recommended if you want to disconnect from the city buzz for a bit! || Beautiful hike and pretty flowers and the city view is amazing!! || Admirable park at the mountain border between St.Gervasi and Vallcarca. Remarkable spot for catching sight of Barcelona till the sea. Wonderful facilities for dogs compared to the usual smaller pet areas of Barcelona parks. Terrific for a reading session surrounded by leafy trees and chirping birds. || My favourite park in Barcelona. Great view, really quiet. Also good for some cardio work. And I sometimes go to the dogs park there and watch then play - really funny. || This is truly a hidden gem in Barcelona. I did not know it was a hilly park so i was very shocked to see the amount of stairs! Definitely keep this in mind if you have trouble climbing stairs but on the flip side it would be a great spot for outdoor exercise. There is even a bit of stationary outdoor workout devices at the Mirador 2 location.  From the top you can get views of both sides of Barcelona. Tibidabo in one area and Sagrada Familia, Torre Glories and the rest of the city down below. Really picturesque and, I imagine, romantic at and after sunset (maybe a nice date idea!)  Only downside for me was (unfortunately) the amount of dog poop around. It is a dog friendly park so it’s up to owners to clean up after their pets. Thankfully most of it was on the walk up to the park and the ground level of the park entrance.  Hope you enjoy your visit! || Amazing spot to appreciate the sunset, but there is a iron gauze for protection, which block the view a bit || Amazing view of the whole city. Will be hard to access if you’re in a wheelchair Super calm and very familial vibes || Nice view and well kept. || Parc del Turó del Putxet is a parc that is away from the crowed. Its relatively unknown by the tourist and therefore more occupied by locals and people that live around that area. Its high and it gives you a great view over the city. || Very nice place to relax and walk around || After a hike to the top, you get treated to one of the best views of (and on) the city. Good option for a relaxing morning. You can also extend your trip by visiting Parc Güell and make it into one big walk/hike. || I live close by, so come here very often for a lovely walk with my dog 🐶 I honestly feel very fortunate to be living few min walking to this beautiful park which has the 360 degree views of Barcelona 🫶🏻 … || The view from here is amazing! Especially from way up the top. Friendly people walking their dogs. Absolutely worth to go up into this garden! || Beautiful park that has a decent view of the city. Not a lot of tourists and plenty of dogs! || Its super nice n big with great views and dog prk || Nice park with good view of city || Nice park with steep walks and nice views... || It is a great place for dogs and people in the heart of the city || Hilly park with wonderful views of the city. Children's playground, dog friendly and with an outdoors gym near the summit. || Chill park with very nice views. Pingpong table present a bit more down in the park. || Beautiful park that take the most of a perfect little hill to get an amazing view of majority of Barcelona from above! also nice variety of plants and flower and a refreshing breeze especially in summer time, with a nice ping pong table as an extra to play if you feel like it ;) || In a central area of Barcelona a quaint park on top of a hill. Great views of the city in a peaceful and quiet surrounding. The neighborhood is tourist free and offers plenty of restaurants and cafes. || A steep walk but beautiful view! || Really nice place, just  seconds from metro line. It is very quiet, have a lot of benches to sit and relax. Has a picturesque view over city. It is frequented by dog owners. If you look for a place to rest in quiet this is the spot. It is close to a very crowded park with Gaudi works. || Great walking around the park. Fantastic views from the hill onto the city. Average size area for children play. Lots of benches on the way up. You can also play table tennis in the park, parang, or just read the book in the shade.On top of the hill there is few tables with benches for picnic. Variety of plants you can find in the park as well as birds and squirrels. Many people walk with their dogs there too. || Amizing views of Barcelona, down toward the Mediterranean sea and upward to the Tibidabo. Good and safe walking path, well maintained trees, flowers and greens. Can be windy on the very top of the Park || Very nice park with a pretty steep walking route. Through the park are multiple spots with an amazing view on Barcelona. If you need to rest you will find enough benches.

place_name: Pla de Palau Lampposts Antoni Gaudí
reviews_content: Beautiful street light from the same set that Anthony Gaudi designed for the Plaça Reial. The lights are certainly beautiful and well designed but it is not something that you should plan to visit by itself. First of all it is very similar to the ones in Plaça Reial and the area is not very interesting. If you already have a walk around like we did then it is very recommended to stop and respect this piece of art. || The first Gaudi design. Impressive. || Nice to pass by and admire if you happen to be in the port area. The details on it are beautiful, another classic piece from Gaudí || Location of farolas (lamp posts) designed by famous catalan architect Antoni Gaudí. Many people pass by this location and don't understand it's importance.  This work thought to have been done in his early days as a commission from the city of Barcelona.  See also the Farolas de Plaça Reial. || We just happened to be close to the lamp post by Gaudi. It was actually a little hard to spot as it is located in the middle of an area. || Beautiful lamppost designed by Gaudi. || It was surrounded by scaffolding so couldn’t get a good look at it. || This beautiful street lamp designed by Antoni Gaudí is located near the Barceloneta metro station. The sidewalk is currently undergoing renovations and there's no direct access to the lamp, but it's still worth admiring. || While Gaudí was studying, he collaborated as a draftsman with Josep Fontserè i Mestre on the entrance gate to Ciutadella Park. Upon completion, Barcelona City Council commissioned him to design the public lighting for two city squares: Plaça Reial and Pla del Palau. The Pla del Palau street lamp consists of only three arms and is less ornate. It is shaped like an inverted crown, supported by three dragons with protruding heads. Architectural style: Modernist Year: 1890 || Beautiful square. Very tree-lined. A major transportation hub. Statues, streetlights, and beautiful buildings. Busy. Bus stop for all parts of Barcelona. One block from the metro.

Looking for something unique, something interesting, you have to find this gem! || This is not a place but an object inside a place (Museu d'Història de Barcelona MUHBA). In Google Maps we add places, not objects from places. || It is a large iron machine (more than 5 tons and 4 meters high) that was commissioned by Flemish clockmakers in 1575 for the cathedral. It is characterized by having no visible hands or dial, as its function was to transmit the hours and quarters to the cathedral bells. After being dismantled in 1864, it was restored in 1976. || One of the beautiful corners of Barcelona

Nice building to look at whole enjoying coffee and experiencing Barcelona. || Great architecture, worth the detour! || Don't waste your time. || Amazing when constructed and is to this day || Very nice,beautiful... || It's a beautiful place || Stunning architecture || Art nouveau, Catalan modernism modernist architecture Built 1902 Antoni Maria Gallissà and Soqué architect || Building with a beautiful, unique facade, it really catches the eye. || This building is part of the modernist style with influences from Islamic architecture. It is considered a cultural asset of Barcelona interest. Multi-family housing estate, on a chamfer and dividing with the respective adjacent ones, both on Valencia Street and Bailèn Street. The building was designed with the trends that were in vogue in Barcelona at that time; the chromatic combination that produces a facade solved with exposed brick -ground floor, upper floor and framing of the architectural holes- and stucco with sgraffito (collaboration with the architect Josep María Jujol). Continuing with the architectural theme, it is influenced by the aesthetic trends of other eras. However, in the specific case of the Casa Llopis Bofill, the building moves away from the Gothicist trend prevailing in most modernist architects by incorporating elements of the neo-Arabic style such as brick. || It is a Modernist building designed by the architect Antoni M. Gallisà in 1902. Its decorative style on the façade is not medievalist, as is the case with most buildings constructed during that period, but rather features Neo-Moorish lines. Josep Maria Jujol participated in the creation of the sgraffito work that decorates the entire façade.  It is a multi-family residential building, and the entire façade is replete with typical Modernist ornamental details, such as wrought iron, glazed ceramic tiles, stucco, and stained glass windows. || It is incredible and majestic, its ceramics combined with red mahogany, the high relief screen printing, you can be looking at and admiring all its details. || another magnificent modernist building || Manuel Llopis House (1903) València, 339 Barcelona. Architect: Antoni Gallissà i Soqué. Collaborators: Josep M. Jujol. || Built between 1902 and 1903. Architect Antoni Gallissà. Collaborator J.M. Jojo || Very pretty. It has designs that make it stand out with a pleasing aesthetic. || Very pretty facade and thanks to Open House I was able to visit an apartment that the owner very kindly showed us. || Fascinating! A neighborhood with very interesting modernist architecture. || It is a wonderful place for its beauty and engineering in its construction. || One of the most beautiful and original modernist buildings in the Eixample district. || Expert hands and the highest professionalism... || Magnificent modernist building || It was great, recommended!!! || For the architectural design... || It's a pleasure to see. || Unparalleled modernism. || A very interesting place

Seeing another work of art by Gaudí casually walking around Barcelona is just yet another reason to love this city and want to take care of it. This one is quite special, though, as it has a sculpture of the man himself. || Portal Miralles is a little-known work by Antoni Gaudí in the Sarrià neighborhood of Barcelona. Built in 1901 as the entrance to industrialist Hermenegild Miralles' estate, the design reflects Gaudí’s naturalist period.  The gate includes a undulating wall made from stone and finished in white trencadís, Gaudí's signature mosaic technique.
